NOTHING_IS_DISCARDED: The labels for these batches are KEPT and used. They are valid labels written against valid evidence. This file flags a provenance quirk, it does not mark anything for deletion.
what_happened: labC on batches 0024 and 0025 read a packet containing the pocket envelope block while labA and labB on the same batches read the pre-envelope packet. Cause: the batch files were rebuilt with the envelope while run wf_e9c1c64f-d58 was mid-flight, and restored to pre-envelope ~2 min later. 2 of 15 running agents fell inside that window.
impact: on these two batches the three labellers did not read identical evidence, so the chair adjudicated readings from two packet versions. labC may cite a residue the chair's own packet does not contain, which the chair would read as ungrounded.
handling: KEEP the labels. Stamp these 200 pairs `mixed_evidence: true` so any later analysis can condition on it. If a clean re-run is wanted, write it to batch_9024/9025 and MERGE as was done for the earlier 50-pair re-adjudication -- keeping the superseded reading under `previous_adjudication`. Never overwrite and never drop.
note_on_pinning: check_packet_fresh.py's PINNED list concerns PACKET FILES only -- batches 0021-0040 are deliberately held at the pre-envelope render because a labelling run is reading them. No label is stale and no label is excluded.
detected_by: grep -l 'pocket envelope -- REACHABLE SPACE' on the workflow's agent transcripts
